issues.description: The solution implementation of PersonService.savePerson has a different return type than what PersonResource expects (and than the template). PersonResource calls personService.savePerson(...) and uses its return value as a Person to include in the ResponseEntity, but in the solution PersonService.savePerson is declared to return void. This mismatch will cause compilation errors and prevents students from running or studying the provided solution. The template version of PersonService.savePerson returns Person, matching the intended design and PersonResource usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the service and resource signatures consistent. Restore PersonService.savePerson(Person) to return a Person (as in the template) and return the saved or updated Person instance, so PersonResource can return it in the ResponseEntity. Alternatively, if a void service is intended, update PersonResource to call the service and then return the Person provided by the controller (or fetch it) rather than relying on a return value from savePerson. Prefer reverting PersonService.savePerson to 'public Person savePerson(Person person)' and returning the saved/updated person to match the REST contract.
